_schema_note: SCHEMA / DOCUMENTATION TEMPLATE ONLY. Collectors NEVER write this filename. Runtime evidence packs always use OUT_DIR/manifest.json (same field shape). Agents must read manifest.json, not templates/evidence-manifest.json.

index_quality.note: Lower confidence on edges/reach when stubs or collisions are high. stubs>=20 → cap related findings at UNKNOWN.

notes: This file is a schema example only; runtime collectors write manifest.json.
All graph claims in review must cite these files.
tested_count / tests-reach define coverage edges; test path names do not.
Entry reachability: use 07-tags.json + impact/*/paths (from_count==0 candidates on reach hops).
from_count is NOT fan-in — prefer edges_in_count / edges-in callers.
Annotation callbacks: 19-annotation-edges.json when edges-in empty for Spring/Resilience4j.
Resilience: 14-resilience-signals.json — signal hits must become findings or deferred residuals (hard gate).
Design fit: 10-design-fit-signals.json derived locally (no extra CodexQA).
Complexity: 11-complexity-signals.json derived locally (no extra CodexQA).
Dependencies: 12-dependency-signals.json derived locally (no extra CodexQA; no network CVE).
Privacy: 13-privacy-signals.json derived locally (no extra CodexQA; no legal conclusions).
Resilience: 14-resilience-signals.json derived locally (no extra CodexQA; no chaos probes).
Change/rollout: 15-rollout-signals.json derived locally (no extra CodexQA; no ops probes).
Risk tier: 20-risk-tier.json derived locally (T0–T3 blast-radius triage; auth/pay/migration/IaC → T0).
Performance: 21-performance-signals.json derived locally (hot-path/N+1/unbounded-alloc; no profiler).
Observability: 16-observability-signals.json derived locally.
Contract: 17-contract-signals.json derived locally (incl. XSS sinks).
Maintainability: 18-maintainability-signals.json derived locally.
If change-groups empty or all change_status=default, re-index with --diff-base.
primary_language / review_language_focus come from 09-language-profile.json (CodexQA lang_stats).
